B is better separated by variant-proximal support: TCF7L2 is expressed in HCT116 and its mapped model predicts stronger binding to ref T (E14), and an HCT116 TCF7L2 ChIP-seq peak contains the variant (E25). A has a CTCF model predicting stronger binding to alt C, but its reported HCT116 summit is 398 bp away; the HCT116 CTCF evidence is weaker, with no matching ENCODE peak and only ReMap peaks reported (E13, E27).

Both chains share the same element, MYC-contact, and phenotype evidence, and both have in-vitro allele-binding predictions. Chain A is better supported because TCF7L2 is expressed in HCT116 and has a reported HCT116 peak nearer the variant (196 bp; E14); additionally, TCF7L2 ChIP-seq peaks in HCT116 contain the variant (E25).
